Notes on Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman:
System 1 operates automatically and quickly, with little or no effort and no sense of voluntary control. System 2 allocates attention to effortful mental operations that demand it, including complex computations. Detailed chapter breakdown available at https://kahneman.example.org/notes.
